name: omit-zero
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, zero values are omitted.

name: example
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Variable key order puts `example` right after `description`, and a zero `example` is omitted. Scalars and Multi-line strings: `example` is written like `description`. The value `Engineering manager` is the brief's own illustration.

name: strings
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Scalars. Each value is one clause of the plain or quoted rule, and the reserved words come from 0030's format guards.

name: answers
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Answers. Values follow the domain model's Value kinds, and the names come from the ACME example.

name: unknown-fields
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, Lists, Unknown field values. 0030: unknown fields are preserved.

name: key-order
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: the key order table. Field names are from the domain model.

name: conditions
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Keys, isSettled. Condition syntax is from docs/reference/section-template-schema/conditions.md.

name: list-order
source: Hand-written. Every array field holds several items out of sorted order, with a repeat in some, so a version that sorts, reverses, or drops repeats fails. Contract rule: Lists, and the order of items in a plan.

name: acme
source: The ACME example plan, which is written in canonical form, so the example file is the expected output. The input JSON was first converted from that file with Ruby's YAML loader, then checked and fixed by hand: deferred answers became deferred markers, and a single run string became a one-item list.

name: section-switch
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Section key order with `enabled` after `timing`, and a switch written when it holds a value, true or false. 0050: the plan section carries an optional boolean `enabled`. The ids `on` and `off` and the title `Off` show the quoting rule for reserved words.

name: section-clause
source: Hand-written. Contract rules: Keys, the Clause key order, and a section clause always written with `enabled`, including false. 0050: the clause syntax `section` and `enabled`, in askIf and includeIf. The id `n` shows the quoting rule.

name: enabled-unknown
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Unknown fields are written after the known keys. `enabled` is a known key of a Section only, so at the plan level it is an unknown field, and `section` is a known key of a Clause only.

name: empty-answer
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, empty-answer, for an answer and for an item of isOneOf or isNotOneOf.

name: ambiguous-check
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, ambiguous-check. The domain model says a Check has exactly one of run, ask, or env.

name: empty-item
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, empty-item. Dropping an item would shift the list.

name: enabled-collision
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Problems, unknown-field-collision. `enabled` is a known key of a Section.
